title: The Animal That Never Eats
hook: What if an animal never had to eat a bite its whole life?
script: Imagine a creature that never has to eat a single bite its entire life. Deep in the abyss, the giant tube worm Riftia pachyptila does exactly that. But here is the strange part: it has no mouth and no gut at all. It survives solely on bacteria that transform toxic hydrogen sulfide into pure energy. These symbiotic bacteria can make up a staggering 50 percent of its body weight. Its blood-red plume pumps hemoglobin to feed this internal army of microbes. This fueling system lets it grow 30 centimeters in a year, defying all invertebrate limits. It has completely replaced its own digestive organs with a living bacterial colony. That is the secret of the animal that never has to eat.

The ocean floor is stranger than we think.
